panels.title: Storage used

panels.title: Storages
panels.description: Storages reporting now (shared ones once), the ones that reported earlier in the time range but not in the last 2 minutes (went inactive, node down or storage removed), and the fullest one. PVE sends only active storages to the metric server, so a storage that was never active in the range (an unreachable PBS, say) is not counted: `pvesm status` lists those.
